subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only
stimulus: the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1×8= 8 (a) In the evening, a lion entered the cave. (b) One day, he fled from the master's house and took shelter in a cave. (c) Once upon a time, there lived a young man named Androcles. (d) He came near Androcles and lifted his paw. (e) He was caught by a slave-merchant who sold him to a rich man in another country. (f) The lion seemed wounded as he was groaning. (g) His master was very bad and inflicted heavy torture on him. (h) He took the lion’s paw in his hand and removed a big thorn from it. The lion was relieved of his pain.
guide_solution: The parts of the story can appear in the following order: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 c e g b a f d h
